audience: developers and system administrators who run servers and Kubernetes clusters on Civo

useCases.title: List our instances with their status and IP addresses
useCases.text: Lists compute instances in a region, optionally by tag, and reads one for its status, size, public and private IPs, network and firewall.

useCases.title: Check our quota and billable usage
useCases.text: Reads the account limits and current use of CPU cores, RAM, disk and more, and lists billable usage for a period of up to 31 days.

useCases.title: Check what a firewall exposes or add a rule
useCases.text: Lists a firewall's rules with protocol, ports, CIDRs and direction, and adds one rule if you ask. A new rule affects everything using that firewall.

useCases.title: Review clusters, databases and volumes in a region
useCases.text: Lists Kubernetes clusters, managed databases and block-storage volumes. It shows status and versions, and which volumes are unattached.

useCases.title: Check DNS records or add one
useCases.text: Lists the domains hosted at Civo and the records of one domain, filtered by type or name, and adds a record if you ask.

useCases.title: Reboot, stop or start an instance, or change its tags
useCases.text: Reboots an instance softly or hard, powers it off or on, or replaces its full tag list. Stopping takes its services offline.
